item.title: US in closely-guarded talks to open 3 new bases in Greenland
item.description:
📝 Trump said in January that the US should "own" Greenland to prevent Russia or China from taking it. Watch: BBC asks Trump in January why US owning Greenland is importantUS officials have not raised the possibility during talks of somehow seizing control of Greenland, something that Denmark and Nato have publicly rejected. "Needham is running point" on Greenland, said a senior diplomat with knowledge of the talks.

item.title: Supercomputer networking to accelerate large scale AI training
item.description:
📝 May 5, 2026EngineeringSupercomputer networking to accelerate large scale AI trainingLoading…ShareFrontier model training depends on reliable supercomputer networks that can quickly move data between GPUs. With synchronous pretraining – where many GPUs across many computers cooperate in lockstep to train one AI model – this is especially true. It’s a new network protocol built into the latest 800Gb/s network interfaces that lets us spread a single transfer across hundreds of paths, route around failures in microseconds, and run simpler network control planes.
🔗 Read more: https://openai.com/index/mrc-supercomputer-networking/
